#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="03900">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />3900 GQA - Low 2,3-dimethylheptane</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="03900">

Found as part of the Extended Analysis, this exception is generated when a source’s 2,3-Dimethylheptane mole % value exceeds the user defined limit for minimum value for 2,3-Dimethylheptane mole %. For example, the minimum limit for 2,3-Dimethylheptane mole % is set to 0.1000, but the 2,3-Dimethylheptane mole % on the sample is imported at 0.0999.

</div>
